definitions.explanation: The distance from the surface to the bottom, or the quality of being profound.

examples.japanese: この{池|いけ}の{深|ふか}さはどのくらいですか。
{傷|きず}の{深|ふか}さを{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: To check the depth of the wound.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{知識|ちしき}の{深|ふか}さに{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised by the depth of his knowledge.

notes:
{深|ふか}さ is derived from the adjective {深|ふか}い (deep) + さ (nominalizing suffix).

Can be used both literally and figuratively:
- Physical depth: {水|みず}の{深|ふか}さ (water depth)
- Abstract depth: {愛|あい}の{深|ふか}さ (depth of love)
